The team is one of the most historic names in Romanian football and is k...nown by nicknames such as Bătrâna Doamnă (The Old Lady) and Textiliștii (The Textile Workers). Their traditional colors are red and white. The club has won multiple Liga I and Cupa României titles and continues to compete in Liga I, regularly challenging established teams.
